result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends mainly on where your business operates, how many employees you have, and whether you need payroll to integrate with your accounting software.

**If I had to choose one for a typical small business, I'd prioritise ease of use, automatic tax and superannuation calculations, compliance, and accounting integration over the cheapest monthly subscription.**

If you're operating in Australia, I'd look at a different shortlist from the popular US options such as Gusto and ADP.

## Best payroll software in Australia (2026)

Here are the options I'd shortlist\:

![Cloud-Based Payroll Services in Australia: A Complete Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZYkYUJ_i7dEguEqtJeWghzKox2V4iMBF0-msyntAs0KHARkfcw9oD02HgfuLhcuG5Os_seDsMW0p5pIuk2xW-TLpMubSFyuZHMlj7j_kil__cyTenxKPBs813_FE7e6y4sGo4jG2vV3BAcGtHs2ynqW5nRfHLw6T86QMor5VmhjEqg7gTsJjJjbXCuLDyECE?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall for simple payroll)

- Excellent accounting integration.
- STP Phase 2 reporting.
- Employee payslips, leave and super.
- Ideal if you already use Xero.
  
  Payroll included in eligible plans.
  
  [Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![Employment Hero - Which HR Software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hoOMaIHHE1BVK8wWyswfFUWF-4zNLm2VTTf8I0IsZi71QvwwVg013JN6PZd_JzmKlLo5GMH1Nn9Dlq8Awe3_MYWQTya_RX2YJlpU2kxq0LmTpktkVrYam4C6Jqjid1iaOedcQ7rhD-uZbRDBcKqCEBszhJOC_eRUB4bTTF7gnOKcGZ7dKIuzDzdg-ruuRgJy?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Employment Hero**

(Best for award-based employees)

- Modern Award interpretation.
- Rostering and timesheets.
- Payroll, onboarding and HR.
- Particularly useful for hospitality, retail and care businesses.
  
  Payroll pricing starts around \$10 per employee/month, with a minimum charge.
  
  [Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. MYOB**

(Best for very small teams)

- Standalone payroll option.
- Strong Australian compliance features.
- Good accounting integration.
- Payroll Only plan covers up to four employees.
  
  Payroll Only: approximately \$20/month from November 2026.
  
  [MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon**

(Best budget option)

- Affordable payroll.
- STP reporting.
- Superannuation and employee records.
- Suitable for micro businesses.
  
  Plans from approximately \$16/month for up to four employees.
  
  [Reckon website](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

---

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/v2DxdxtjjvEmcT175Hs6YVBjgbAAlKMZDR6USs-77ApdWW6sbAFow9cQJv_MT97jB9zjE3wPxOpKSO9gcLLxLfFypeZvyP5eJvDL5WGyfBsSIqIhU81GbrWMoq4pqjRGs2-V3Eb0qoi-t3xsMSUPgetkp-nB9-Vn5YkmqvxZsrEUOfyJgwiq9_ZT3tLhuZte?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Payroller**

(Best for simple, low-cost payroll)

- Straightforward payroll processing.
- STP Phase 2.
- Mobile-friendly.
- Good for businesses with just one or two employees.
  
  Free limited option available; paid plans also offered.
  
  [Payroller website](https://payroller.com.au/)

From 1 July 2026, Australian employers must generally ensure super contributions reach employees' funds within seven business days of payday. Your software and payment workflow need to accommodate this. search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
